name: audiobook-creator
description: Turns a document's text into a chaptered .m4b audiobook using local, offline neural TTS (Kokoro-82M) -- no cloud API, no per-use cost, no text leaves the machine. Plain narration reads verbatim in one voice; Story mode rewrites dry material into a themed narrative with multi-voice casting. Embedded chapter markers work in Apple Books, Podcasts, and Overcast. Runs as a polled background job. Requires ffmpeg on PATH; the ~120MB model downloads once on first use.
